learningObjective: Reason about the collectives that a partitioner must insert to reshard a tensor between two different sharding specifications on the same device mesh.

hardwareContext.architecture: Multi-GPU cluster with a 1-D device mesh of size N

stem: A tensor T of shape [D0, D1] lives on an N-device 1-D mesh. Consider the following reshard requests. Which TWO of the following mappings between reshard requests and required collectives are correct?

options.text: From 'sharded along D0 (each rank has [D0/N, D1])' to 'fully replicated on all ranks': the partitioner inserts an AllGather along the mesh axis.
From 'partial-sum on all ranks (each rank has a partially reduced [D0, D1] whose sum equals T)' to 'fully replicated': the partitioner inserts an AllReduce along the mesh axis.
From 'sharded along D0' to 'sharded along D1' (both along the same mesh axis): the partitioner inserts a local reshape only, since the total per-rank byte count is unchanged.
From 'fully replicated' to 'sharded along D0': the partitioner inserts an AllReduce (sum) followed by a local slice, in order to guarantee that no rank keeps a stale replica.

explanation: A and B are the canonical reshards emitted by GSPMD-style partitioners: sharded→replicated is AllGather (assembling shards); partial→replicated is AllReduce (summing partial contributions). C is wrong: changing the sharded dimension across the same mesh axis requires All-to-All (a permutation), not a local reshape. D is wrong: replicated→sharded is a local slice with no collective, since every rank already has the full tensor.

optionExplanations.A: Correct: standard sharded→replicated reshard is AllGather.
optionExplanations.C: Wrong: this requires All-to-All, not a local reshape.
optionExplanations.D: Wrong: replicated→sharded needs no collective, only a local slice.

assumptions: The mesh is 1-D of size N.
nonImplications: Does not imply that the partitioner always chooses the cheapest reshard; consumer-driven decisions can propagate cost upstream.
Does not imply that a partial-sum tensor is invalid — it is a valid intermediate sharding.

distractorRationales.C: Confuses per-rank byte count with reshard cost.
distractorRationales.D: Overcompensates by inserting a spurious AllReduce.
